You need a version of Android based on AOSP and make sure not to flash GAPPS with it. AOSP (Android Open Source Project) is all of Android without the Google stuff. There are tons of flavors for tons of devices so you need to make sure you pick a device that is able to be flashed to a version you like. This will limit the applications you can install so you will need to get your apps from F-Droid (https://f-droid.org/)) or some other repository instead of the Play Store.

Next, you will need to find out what mail and calendar apps have open source versions or just use the browser version for them. Same applies for other apps, mainly you will wind up using bookmarks to get to these things. Pale Moon or Brave are good browsers.

And use Startpage or ixquick for searching. They use Google to ennhance their searches, but in an anonymous way. DuckDuckGo is the go to for many but I can't get into their style.

Use Waterfox on your desktop as it is based off Firefox but doesn't have all the crap on top. Best browser I have found.
